entities.name: Paging for SMS
entities.description: Network-initiated paging procedure triggered when receiving an incoming mobile terminating SMS for a UE without an existing NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: IMSI attached for non-EPS services or SMS only
entities.description: Condition where UE is IMSI attached for non-EPS services or for SMS only.

entities.name: Attached for EPS services with CIoT optimization and SMS only in NB-S1 mode
entities.description: Condition where UE is attached for EPS services with CIoT EPS optimization, has requested SMS only, and is in NB-S1 mode.

entities.name: No NAS signalling connection exists
entities.description: Condition indicating absence of an active NAS signalling connection between UE and network.

entities.name: No paging restriction applied
entities.description: Condition where network has not applied any paging restrictions for the UE.

entities.name: Extended DRX parameters
entities.description: IE containing eDRX parameters provided to UE during attach or tracking area updating procedures.

entities.name: T3413
entities.description: Timer that is not started during paging for SMS procedure.

entities.name: T3415
entities.description: Timer that is not started during paging for SMS procedure.

entities.name: Paging time window
entities.description: Time window during which network initiates paging for UEs using eDRX when SMS is received.

entities.name: Negotiated UE paging probability information
entities.description: Paging probability information available in EMM context and provided to lower layers during paging.

relations.description: Paging for SMS procedure is triggered when UE is IMSI attached for non-EPS services or SMS only.
Paging for SMS procedure is triggered when UE is attached for EPS services with CIoT optimization and SMS only in NB-S1 mode.
Paging for SMS procedure requires that no NAS signalling connection exists.
Paging for SMS procedure requires that no paging restriction is applied in the network.
Paging procedure timing for eDRX UEs depends on Extended DRX parameters IE values.
MME shall not start timer T3413 during paging for SMS procedure.
MME shall not start timer T3415 during paging for SMS procedure.
Paging for SMS procedure for eDRX UEs is initiated within the paging time window.
EMM entity provides negotiated UE paging probability information to lower layers during paging.
